description: Zonering aanvliegroute vliegveld (geluid) (OGV, 2010) (historie) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dit bestand geeft de zonering van de radiotelescopen weer zoals opgenomen in kaart 12 (Overige aanduidingen) van de in de door Provinciale Staten van Drenthe op 2 juni 2010 vastgestelde Omgevingsvisie. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are omgevingsvisie. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
